$comment: Generated by `pnpm compose:facts`; re-run it to regenerate. Entry text is not edited by hand.
One model-written sentence per verified fact. Each is re-checked at build; a stale
or failing sentence is rejected and its fact uses the built-in template.
After a registry change makes a sentence stale, that entry may be removed by hand; the site serves the template either way.
